description: This file defines types and methods related to Kubernetes variable management within the kustomize tool, including Var, Target, FieldSelector, and VarSet, with functions for defaulting, deep equality, and set operations.

classes.name: Var
classes.description: Represents a Kubernetes variable sourced from an object field.

classes.name: Target
classes.description: Refers to a Kubernetes object by Group, Version, Kind, and Name.

classes.name: FieldSelector
classes.description: Contains the field path to an object field.

classes.name: VarSet
classes.description: A set of Vars with unique names, supporting set operations.

methods.name: Defaulting
methods.description: Sets default field path if not specified.

methods.name: DeepEqual
methods.description: Checks deep equality between two Vars.

methods.name: AsSlice
methods.description: Returns the set of Vars as a slice.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the VarSet.

methods.name: MergeSet
methods.description: Merges another VarSet, error on duplicate names.

methods.name: MergeSlice
methods.description: Merges a slice of Vars, error on duplicates.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges a single Var, error on duplicate name.

methods.name: AbsorbSet
methods.description: Absorbs another VarSet, error on conflicts.

methods.name: AbsorbSlice
methods.description: Absorbs a slice of Vars, error on conflicts.

methods.name: Absorb
methods.description: Absorbs a single Var, error on conflicts.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a VarSet contains a given Var.
